_comment: Tier-2 for sparta rarefied_flow: in a driven run the two opposed wall fluxes must balance, and that balance rather than the step count is the convergence test. Two decks were run on the installed binary (SPARTA 24 Sep 2025, spa_serial), identical but for the seed: a 2d argon slab between a hot diffuse wall on ylo and a cold one on yhi, started from a uniform gas at the cold temperature. 'compute boundary all etot' is read every step for 3000 steps and block-averaged into ten windows here rather than in SPARTA, so the averaging window is explicit. Both runs exit 0 with no error and no warning throughout — the run looks perfectly healthy during the transient, which is the point. The energy-flux imbalance between the two walls starts at 0.66 and 0.70 in the first window (the hot wall is putting in several times what the cold wall takes out) and decays through the transient into the low thousandths. THRESHOLD SET BY MEASUREMENT, NOT BY GUESS, because this is a Monte-Carlo tally: the noise floor is measured from the late windows of seed A (0.0192) and every assertion is then made against seed B, so nothing is tested against a floor derived from itself. Seed B's late windows all sit inside three times that floor, and BOTH seeds' first window is more than ten times outside it. No imbalance value is pinned, no wall-clock is read, and the run length is fixed so the comparison is between windows of one run rather than between runs of different length. COVERS: rarefied_flow:8. MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 prepends a DISCARDED warm-up run of the same length and forms the windows from the second run only (stats_rows keeps the last stats table), so the measured windows start in steady state. Seeds, grid, walls, window count and drive are untouched; only the transient is removed. Against the measured floor: the first-window imbalance falls from 0.663 (seed A) and 0.6951 (seed B) to 0.00704 and 0.01037, against a seed-A late-window floor of 0.03803 -- the signal lands ON the floor instead of 17x outside it. the_two_opposed_walls_carry_opposite_signed_flux stays True under mutation, which is the point: the drive is intact, only the transient is gone. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES (rc=0); with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS (rc=1) and these expect_in_output strings go False and disappear: the_FIRST_window_is_more_than_10x_the_floor=True, the_imbalance_decays_through_the_transient=True. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/sparta/wall_flux_balance_is_the_convergence_test && python source.py (passes, rc=0), then T2_MUTATE=1 python source.py (fails, rc=1). Needs a SPARTA binary: the fixtures find spa_serial/spa_mpi on PATH or at ~/Schreibtisch/sparta/src/spa_serial, else set SPARTA_BINARY; with none present they exit 0 on a SKIP: line.
